WITH date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE)
),
store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_range dr ON dr.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk
),
store_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk,
           SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_range dr ON dr.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
    GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk
),
store_agg AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(sa.store_sk, ra.store_sk) AS store_sk,
           COALESCE(sa.sales, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2))) AS sales,
           COALESCE(sa.profit, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2))) AS profit,
           COALESCE(ra.returns, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2))) AS returns,
           COALESCE(ra.profit_loss, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2))) AS profit_loss
    FROM store_sales_agg sa
    FULL OUTER JOIN store_returns_agg ra ON sa.store_sk = ra.store_sk
),
ssr AS (
    SELECT st.s_store_id,
           SUM(sa.sales) AS sales,
           SUM(sa.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(sa.returns) AS returns,
           SUM(sa.profit_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM store_agg sa
    JOIN store st ON st.s_store_sk = sa.store_sk
    GROUP BY st.s_store_id
),
catalog_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
           SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_range dr ON dr.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_catalog_page_sk
),
catalog_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT cr.cr_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
           SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS returns,
           SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_range dr ON dr.d_date_sk = cr.cr_returned_date_sk
    GROUP BY cr.cr_catalog_page_sk
),
catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(csa.page_sk, cra.page_sk) AS page_sk,
           COALESCE(csa.sales, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2))) AS sales,
           COALESCE(csa.profit, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2))) AS profit,
           COALESCE(cra.returns, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2))) AS returns,
           COALESCE(cra.profit_loss, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2))) AS profit_loss
    FROM catalog_sales_agg csa
    FULL OUTER JOIN catalog_returns_agg cra ON csa.page_sk = cra.page_sk
),
csr AS (
    SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
           SUM(ca.sales) AS sales,
           SUM(ca.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(ca.returns) AS returns,
           SUM(ca.profit_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM catalog_agg ca
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = ca.page_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id
),
web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk,
           SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_range dr ON dr.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk
),
web_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk,
           SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_range dr ON dr.d_date_sk = wr.wr_returned_date_sk
    LEFT OUTER JOIN web_sales ws ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
                                AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(wsa.wsr_web_site_sk, wra.wsr_web_site_sk) AS wsr_web_site_sk,
           COALESCE(wsa.sales, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2))) AS sales,
           COALESCE(wsa.profit, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2))) AS profit,
           COALESCE(wra.returns, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2))) AS returns,
           COALESCE(wra.profit_loss, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2))) AS profit_loss
    FROM web_sales_agg wsa
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_returns_agg wra ON wsa.wsr_web_site_sk = wra.wsr_web_site_sk
),
wsr AS (
    SELECT site.web_site_id,
           SUM(wa.sales) AS sales,
           SUM(wa.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(wa.returns) AS returns,
           SUM(wa.profit_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM web_agg wa
    JOIN web_site site ON site.web_site_sk = wa.wsr_web_site_sk
    GROUP BY site.web_site_id
)
SELECT channel,
       id,
       SUM(sales) AS sales,
       SUM(returns) AS returns,
       SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
           'store' || s_store_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM ssr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
           'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM csr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
           'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM wsr
) x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100
